overview: Three 1946 messages trace engineering adviser Becker's appointment, Army travel arrangements for Korea service, and final salary settlement via the Seoul political adviser's office, though filed under Japan.

people.name: Maxwell E. Becker
people.role: Engineering adviser and appointee in the State Department-sponsored group traveling to Korea

people.name: Edwin M. Martin
people.role: Chief of a Department of State division concerned with Japanese and Korean economic affairs; the division titles are garbled in the OCR

people.name: Arthur C. Bunce
people.role: Leader associated with Becker’s adviser group, as implied by the telegram; the surname is apparently misread by OCR

people.name: Colbert
people.role: Department of State staff member appearing in the telegram’s preparation notation

people.name: J. Moore
people.role: Staff member appearing in telegram preparation or routing notation

subfiles.title: Telegram confirming Becker’s appointment as engineering adviser
subfiles.from: Edwin M. Martin, Department of State
subfiles.about: The State Department confirms Becker’s appointment and promises further instructions about pay and Army-arranged travel.
subfiles.summary: Martin confirms Becker's appointment as engineering adviser, asking where to send his salary checks.

subfiles.title: Secret telegram on financial and travel arrangements for Korea
subfiles.from: Edwin M. Martin, Department of State
subfiles.to: Maxwell E. Becker (inferred from context and address)
subfiles.about: The State Department gives Becker financial, permit, and scheduling instructions for his journey to Korea.
subfiles.summary: Secret telegram covers Becker's travel and pay arrangements for his Korea assignment.

subfiles.title: Airgram requesting Becker’s final salary-payment letter
subfiles.from: Department of State, signed Byrnes; Acheson also named
subfiles.about: The Department instructs the political adviser in Seoul to submit the documentation required for Becker’s final salary payment.
subfiles.summary: Airgram requests Becker's final salary-payment letter for processing by the Finance Division.

interest: Shows 1946 State-Army coordination to send an engineering adviser to Korea, misfiled under Japan.
